content.short: SODAX is a cross-network execution and liquidity system for complex multi-chain flows.
content.description: SODAX is a cross-network execution and liquidity system for applications that need complex financial actions without building cross-chain infrastructure themselves. Its HTTP API and TypeScript SDK quote and execute cross-network swaps, and the same SDK covers supplying, borrowing, withdrawing and repaying in lending markets. Asset transfers move through hub-and-spoke vaults via a separate bridge SDK, and leveraged yield vaults can be entered and exited programmatically. Separate guides cover HTTP, Solana and AI agent integrations.
content.meta: SODAX is a cross-network execution and liquidity system whose API and SDK handle swaps, lending, bridging and yield vaults across chains.
